notes: Three distinct localized open-close interaction episodes are visible. The opening transition is treated as the on transition and the closing transition as the off transition; the initial and final room traversals are not counted.
scene_description: Modern kitchenette with dark integrated cabinetry, a tall refrigerator and lower freezer at the right end, a sink and integrated dishwasher under the counter, and folding chairs against the adjacent white wall.
